task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml (all criterion ids and weights; job_open, add_candidate, add_email_rules, anonymous text)
evidence: Brief (task/instruction.md:1-17) asks for a complete multi-user full-stack product, not a tweak: Node/Express/SQLite app in an empty /app (environment/Dockerfile:17-23 only creates /app with .gitkeep; no starter code), four roles with 401/403/404 rules (hireops_rules.md:9-23), job/candidate creation with validation (:25-38), six-stage board with one-stage moves, reject/reopen, manual ordering, interview capacity, role limits, optimistic-version 409 conflicts, optimistic put-back, atomic multi-card moves and undo with conflict rules (:40-106), activity log (:108-113), live updates within 15 s that preserve focus/drafts/scroll (:115-123), conversations with 30-message paging, scroll anchoring, per-person unread, seen marks and per-user browser drafts surviving sign-out (:125-175), candidate portal with wording table and data redaction (:177-194), persistence/seeding/restart (instruction.md:13-15, integration.md:1-19). Golden needs about 1,410 lines of JS (src/index.js 450, board.js 373, threads.js 223, app.js 213, db.js 88, bootstrap.js 61). Smallest submission that meets the brief: a real server-backed multi-role app; a static page, mock or single CRUD screen does not meet the ask. Grading also separates a stub: gates/render (sign-in with an invalid-password control and a usable workspace; a 'static picture or only a health response is insufficient') and gates/constraints (UI-created job plus candidate read back in an independent browser context; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate'), both all_pass gates with weight 0 (tests/scoring.toml:1-3). Functional has 43 binary criteria with total weight 58.5 (computed with tomllib), plus floor functional=0.05 (scoring.toml:10-11; score.py:47-48 gives reward 0 unless every floor is exceeded). Stub probe (arithmetic, not run): sign-in plus job/candidate CRUD passes both gates, but scores at most hro_job_open 0.5 + hro_add_candidate 0.5 + hro_add_email_rules 1 = 2/58.5 = 0.034 < 0.05 floor -> reward 0. A stub that also adds clean 401s (hro_anonymous 1.5; it needs move/undo/message requests to exist, so a stub probably cannot earn it) would reach 0.060, which only just clears the floor; then reward is about 0.036 + 0.2*visual, so at most about 0.2 with perfect visuals, versus about 1.0 for a full build. That is bounded partial credit, not 'the reward'. Conforming alternative: the brief leaves routes, ids, labels, layout and the live-update transport open (hireops_rules.md:3-5, :123; instruction.md:11,13), and the gates rely only on brief-stated actions (recruiter opens job with places and adds candidate, rules section 2; observer reads board, section 1). I found no hidden mandate in the gates that a real conforming app would fail on this row. Evidence integrity: raw-evidence-index.json artifact hashes (workspace.cjs, results/workspace.json, server.log, 3 PNGs) and their matching_source_files hashes all match the current files and frozen bytes (verified with hashlib). It holds only scripted golden observations; its own scope says 'reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'. Risk=true only because no weak/stub app has been measured through the configured judge, so the claim that a stub is excluded rests on arithmetic over criteria weights and floor. The brief-side requirement for this row is met.
